headline: WSN @ CLE matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is WSN 3.61 at CLE 5.04, with a projected total of 8.65. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CLE: WSN moved -0.91 runs while CLE moved +0.10, changing the projected margin by -1.00 runs. The projected total fell -0.81, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +11.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Zack Littell has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Daylen Lile, Travis Bazzana, José Ramírez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags José Tena because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
